Raw Data

Pacing snapshots every quarter at day 48 (Method C): cohort = deals entering from-stage in the first 48 days of the quarter; converted = of that cohort, reached to-stage by day 48 of the same quarter. Matches elapsed time in current quarter Q3 2026 (up through yesterday). Conversion = deals reaching "To Stage" / deals that entered "From Stage" in that quarter.
